name: input
summary: Text input. A type-router (text/password/number/search/textarea/datetime). v-model is value+update. Almost always wrapped by FlotoFormItem for label+validation.

type.note: routes to a-input / a-input[type=password] / MInputNumber / MInputSearch / a-textarea / date-picker

label.note: form-item label above the field (FlotoFormItem pattern); a red required * is appended when `required`. Linked to the field via for/id.

help.note: supporting/hint text below the field (Ant form-explain), muted --neutral-light. Hidden when an error-message shows.

allowClear.note: shows an x to clear when there's a value (218x incl. pickers)

maxlength.note: native char cap (7x); no built-in counter — show-count NOT supported by Ant 1.4 kit

(a-input attrs).note: disabled, readOnly, maxLength via $attrs. size (small/default/large) exists but EFFECTIVELY UNUSED — one height (32px; search 36px)

accessibility.semantics: native input/textarea; label via FlotoFormItem or aria-label
accessibility.placeholder: ~50% color (--input-placeholder-color) — verify contrast; not a label substitute

decisionFlow: A date/time? -> date picker, not a text input.
[Field] In a form with a label/validation? -> wrap in FlotoFormItem (the norm).
[Style] Dense/inline underline look? -> .material-input. Unit/protocol attached? -> addonBefore/addonAfter. Context icon? -> prefix/suffix.

password.dontUse: when a show/hide toggle is needed (use PasswordInput) — type=password has none (F2)

search.useWhen: a search box (Enter emits search, has an enter button)

prefix/suffix.useWhen: a context icon inside the field (search glass, unit)

material-input.useWhen: a dense/inline Material underline look (bottom border only)

allow-clear.useWhen: an optional field/search where clearing to empty is valid

error-state.note: .has-error red border applied by FlotoFormItem; always pair with an inline message

disabled-vs-readonly.useWhen: disabled = can't interact (greyed); read-only = selectable/copyable but not editable (view mode)

FlotoFormItem.useWhen: any input in a form — adds the label + validation (the standard pattern, 1783x)

no-border-input.useWhen: A borderless field for inline editing — no visible box until interacted with, so the value reads like plain text in place. Rare (3x); use only where the field lives inside a larger surface and a border would add visual noise.
no-border-input.dontUse: Don't use for normal form fields where users need to see the editable affordance — use the default bordered text input, or .material-input for a dense-but-visible underline. Reserve no-border for true inline-edit-in-place spots.
no-border-input.example: An inline-editable label/title edited directly in place (e.g. renaming an item where the value sits inline, no form box), one of the ~3 borderless inline-edit spots.

autocomplete (search + suggestions).useWhen: a SEARCH field whose suggestions come from what the user TYPES (search-as-you-type) — a live suggestion list, keyboard-navigable
autocomplete (search + suggestions).dontUse: picking from a known fixed list (use the Dropdown picker / Select); a plain search that just filters a list shown elsewhere (use type=search with no suggestion list).
autocomplete (search + suggestions).example: the global omnibox search, metric/counter search-ahead, host/monitor name suggestions (auto-complete-list.vue / omnibox).

do: Wrap inputs in FlotoFormItem for label + validation (standard form pattern).
Pick the type for the data; bind with v-model.
Use prefix/suffix for context icons; addonBefore/addonAfter for units/protocols.
dont: Don't rely on @input to update the model — it's @update (F1).
Don't use the placeholder as the only label.
Don't expect a password show/hide toggle from type=password (F2).
whenToUse: Capturing typed input (text/number/search/multi-line) on a form or toolbar.
knownIssues: F1 (low): v-model event is 'update' not 'input' — @input won't update the model; use @update or v-model. Align to input/update:value in a future API pass.
F2 (low): type=password has no show/hide toggle (falls to a-input[type=password]); a separate PasswordInput exists. Route to a-input-password or point to PasswordInput.
F3 (high, a11y): inputs strip the focus outline — no visible focus ring (SF-001).
[element] obs-input element: emits `input` per keystroke + `change` on blur; el.value now reflects typed text. Event detail is an array (unwrap detail[0]).
changelog: 2026-08-06 — BUGFIX (owner report): text fields would not accept typing and sometimes showed "0". Cause: the inner native <input>/<textarea> `input` event is composed:true, so it escaped the shadow DOM and collided with our emit("input") — consumers reading e.detail got 0 (UIEvent default), blanked the field, and 0||"" cleared it. Fix: stop the native input/change from leaving the shadow root (@input.stop / e.stopPropagation) so only our clean CustomEvent (detail=[value]) is seen; also normalise value as v==null?"":String(v) so a real 0 shows "0". Verified controlled (e.detail) + uncontrolled typing.

2026-06-07: added (decision-grade from the start). 293x; type-router; v-model value/update; prefix/suffix/addon slots; .material-input 62x (bottom-border) verified. F1-F3. FlotoFormItem (1783x) noted as the field wrapper (own entry next).
2026-07-09: material variant now has a transparent background (elements@0.1.14) — was inheriting the box's white fill, so .material-input showed a filled box instead of just the underline.

2026-07-08: added `label` + `help` to obs-input (elements@0.1.10) so the field carries its own FlotoFormItem-style label (0.8rem, --text-color-common-secondary, red required * after) + supporting/hint text below (--neutral-light) — self-contained form fields without a separate wrapper. Label is for/id-linked to the field (a11y).

2026-07-11: documented AUTOCOMPLETE as a variant of Input (search + live suggestions) rather than a standalone component (owner decision) — a search-as-you-type field whose options come from the query, not a fixed list. Storybook: Atoms/Input → Autocomplete. Distinct from Dropdown/Select.

a11y.summary: Native <input>/<textarea>, correct roles + text-editing keys. Always label (FlotoFormItem or aria-label). type=search adds Enter→search.
issues: type=password has no show/hide (F2) — use PasswordInput.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.
